title: A Brother and a Lost Toy
text:
Leyla and Can are brothers. Leyla is older, and Can is ten years old. They share a small room in their house. Every night, Leyla reads a story to Can before he sleeps.

One day, Can lost his favorite toy car. Leyla felt sorry for him, so she searched the whole house with him. They finally found the car under the sofa. Can gave Leyla a big hug and said thank you.

questions.text: Where did they find the toy car?
How does Can probably feel about Leyla at the end of the story?
What kind of relationship do Leyla and Can seem to have?

vocabulary.definition: to use or have something together with another person
after a long time or a lot of effort

paragraph_translations: Leyla ve Can kardeştir. Leyla ablası ve Can on yaşında. Evlerinde küçük bir odayı paylaşırlar. Her gece Leyla, Can uyumadan önce ona bir hikaye okur.

Bir gün Can en sevdiği oyuncak arabasını kaybetti. Leyla onun için üzüldü, bu yüzden onunla birlikte bütün evi aradı. Sonunda arabayı koltuğun altında buldular. Can Leyla'ya sıkı bir sarılma verdi ve teşekkür etti.
